name: P2P Market
description: Decentralized trade node on Base L2: every company website is an autonomous trading node. Domain-linked on-chain business profiles, USDC escrow settlement, and semantic search for humans and AI agents over MCP. No platform commissions, no listing rules, no ad-driven rankings.

itemOffered.name: Domain-linked business profile registration on Base

makesOffer.description: Flat anti-spam fee, paid in Base ETH at the live Chainlink ETH/USD rate. Binds the company domain to its Web3 wallet in the on-chain registry (setProfile).

itemOffered.name: USDC escrow settlement for trade deals

makesOffer.description: 0.1% of the deal amount, taken at escrow funding on Base. Net-30/60 post-paid invoices carry no percentage.

itemOffered.name: AI semantic search and MCP toolkit

makesOffer.description: Client-side AI agents (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor) search the registry and read registered business cards free of charge.

potentialAction.description: The platform node invites ecosystem service providers to register their own nodes and join the deal validation, insurance and logistics layers of the protocol.

itemOffered.name: Independent deal auditors and validators (Contract Type 4)
Cargo insurers with USDC-parametric coverage (Contract Type 6)
Logistics partners providing on-chain delivery attestations

x-agent-instructions.privateData: Confidential price lists and exclusive commercial terms are NOT published in this file. They are served per-partner over HTTPS only after the on-chain mutual handshake (Contract Type 2) and a SIWE (EIP-4361) authenticated session.
x-agent-instructions.searchHint: Use the MCP toolkit (mcp.p2pmarket.net/sse) or /api/ai-search to discover other registered nodes before contacting them.
